name: inprocess-obi-axil-uart-zipdma-route-write-f1f6
description: One Ibex RVFI OBI CPU with one real AXI4-Lite ZipCPU UART and a ZipDMA: the master pushes the RAM source block into the UART TXREG through the target's own AW/W/B channels, and the case line states the target's channel counters and the FIFO status readback.

evidence.source: third_party/soc-zipcpu-wbuart/rtl/wbuart.v:119-137 (uart_setup is written from the four byte lanes of UART_SETUP) and 513 (a read of UART_SETUP returns {1'b0, uart_setup}), so the word the master pushed last is the word the CPU reads back

notes: the routed register is SETUP (offset 0x00) and the declared evidence is SETUP itself: the RTL stores the four byte lanes of the write into the 31-bit uart_setup register and a read returns {1'b0, uart_setup} (wbuart.v:119-137,513), so the AXI4-Lite readback after the transfer is exactly the last word the master pushed.  A TXREG write route was tried and rejected for the same device fact as the Wishbone scenario: the transmitter drains one entry per push, so the whole-word FIFO_STATUS readback would not change
the four routed beats present the same fixed target address, so the last one wins: the RAM source block (the F6 record's words) is the data the master pushes

the routed target is the pinned ZipCPU axiluart AXI4-Lite slave behind the generated axi4_lite_mmio_bridge; the host presents the routed beat on the same generic request port the CPU's own MMIO uses, and the bridge drives AW/W/B or AR/R and returns the slave's R data as the beat's response
the target is mapped at 0x20006000 rather than its SoC 0x40000000 because the pinned ZipDMA's SOURCE/DESTINATION CSR fields are 30-bit byte addresses: a byte address >= 0x40000000 cannot be encoded
rx=1 and cts_n=0 are the same pin constants the F2/F4 AXI4-Lite scenario declares for this slave; SETUP 0 (rw), FIFO_STATUS 4 (ro), RXREG 8 (rw) and TXREG 12 (rw) are the four declared registers
the RAM source block is the four input words the F6 record carries, so the pushed bytes are the record's own data
